name: Router::prune_tools

test_list.description: Output never exceeds the caller's nonzero top-k bound.
An S1 outage returns a deterministic lexical shortlist.
Only bounded summary prefixes participate in lexical filtering and S1 context.
Duplicate IDs and excessive candidate/query/name sizes are rejected before scoring.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Caller-supplied tool IDs and untrusted names and summaries.

output_description: A unique, bounded shortlist of supplied tool IDs with semantic or lexical scores.
